1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Nxe5 Nxe5.strategy: Chases the c6 knight again with a pawn, gaining space at the cost of time. White keeps the gambit going and plays for speed instead of material, but the pawn on d5 is also a target and Black has good ways to meet the attack.

Jumps back to e5 and keeps the piece, but the knight can be chased again and White's central pawns gain more space with each move. Black's pieces are pushed about and White's attack is dangerous in practice, so the defence has to be exact.
